info.title: School Wall Mobile API
info.description: Actual supported /api/v1 JSON API. Legacy /api payloads remain unchanged; v1 wraps JSON while preserving HTTP status. Bearer JWT, endpoint-specific pagination, live quote visibility and one-sided deletion are preserved. SQLite local timestamps have no UTC offset; UTC vote deadlines are ISO strings. Use HTTPS in production. No default/public account credentials or real user examples are included.

get.summary: Page, search, poll or locate visible private messages
get.description: before/after/around_id are mutually exclusive. All returned messages are ascending by id; initial request returns the latest page. Pagination flags reflect the authorized result set. Neither sender nor receiver can read messages hidden on their own side. Render reply_to dynamically; unavailable/revoked quoted content is cleared.

parameters.description: Exclusive older cursor.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Exclusive newer cursor for incremental polling.

parameters.name: around_id
parameters.description: Visible same-conversation anchor. Hidden/foreign anchor returns 404.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Literal content search; may combine with before, never after/around_id.

parameters.name: mark_read
parameters.description: Default GET marks returned received visible messages read. Use 0 for search/context previews.

post.summary: Send private message or wall-scoped confession with optional reply
post.description: Private: accepted friend OR shared active wall, no block, active recipient, no anonymous flag. Confession: both active members of selected wall. Reply source must be visible, same participants/type/wall, nonanonymous and not revoked. A supplied client_message_id is unique per sender: replaying the same normalized payload returns the existing id with deduplicated=true. Different payload returns 409 CLIENT_MESSAGE_CONFLICT. Hidden/revoked original returns 409 CLIENT_MESSAGE_UNAVAILABLE. Never generate a new cid merely because a response was lost.
